fixes.old: The 5-minute timer check is retired: durable timers live inside each workflow. D-RCV-36 T2 keeps the TimerScheduler port for Epic 1 and Epic 2 only (GAP-0042; ASM-0060).
fixes.new: The 5-minute timer check is retired: durable timers live inside each workflow. D-RCV-36 T2 keeps the TimerScheduler port for Epic 1 and Epic 2 only (GAP-0042; ASM-0060). Durable timers replace the five-minute timer check and PLT owns the shared timer library (GAP-0032).

fixes.old: Outbox relay to Kafka in every service, part of the service template and the shared libraries; each service runs its own relay, so there is no Schedule (ASM-0063).
fixes.new: Outbox relay to Kafka in every service, part of the service template and the shared libraries; each service runs its own relay, so there is no Schedule (ASM-0063). The outbox relay is a platform library owned by PLT; no service builds its own (GAP-0035).

fixes.old: Continuous DecisionRecorded ingest from Kafka in rwb-decision; the nightly copy to the data lake is removed with the data lake, so JOB-13 has no nightly run (GAP-0044; ASM-0064).
fixes.new: Continuous DecisionRecorded ingest from Kafka in rwb-decision; the nightly copy to the data lake is removed with the data lake, so JOB-13 has no nightly run (GAP-0044; ASM-0064). The daily ledger seal (WORM) in rwb-decision replaces the data lake copy; no data lake remains in scope (GAP-0036).

fixes.old: The bank's Airflow triggers the extract at 01:30 and re-runs any business date; rwb-reporting builds it from its own projections with no data lake. Architecture v5 slides 15 and 31 also describe a 01:30 Schedule (GAP-0045; ASM-0065).
fixes.new: The bank's Airflow triggers the extract at 01:30 and re-runs any business date; rwb-reporting builds it from its own projections with no data lake. Architecture v5 slides 15 and 31 also describe a 01:30 Schedule (GAP-0045; ASM-0065). The reporting extract is the regulatory extract, sent through rwb-integration; no data lake remains in scope (GAP-0037).
